lines.text: The Farrier Science program at Mesalands Community
College offers an Associate of Applied Science degree as
Farrier Science is primarily a self-employed field; there-
fore, farriers must be knowledgeable and skilled in all
facets of the business. The Farrier Science degree
program offers hands-on practical experience in horse-
manship, trimming and shoeing, and forging and
welding. Instruction in anatomy and physiology, busi-
ness management, and other aspects of horseshoeing
The degree program also offers an in-depth study of
therapeutic and pathological shoeing, including the
physiology, forging and application of shoes.
